arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Yang argued the EAJA requires fee awards to prevailing parties.
Mr. Leach argued Catherine Ratliff is entitled to receive the fee.
Mr. Leach stated Congress invited her to prove the government was wrong.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Equal Access to Justice Act mandates fee awards to prevailing parties. The government argues courts can pay attorneys directly. The client argues the statute requires payment to the party.
